summary: The Boards tool window's Id is translated (L.T), so its saved layout depends on the language
description: BoardsToolWindowViewModel.Id => L.T("Boards"): ids are saved in settings and must not be translated (PLUGINS.md, ToolWindowViewModelBase: "Don't rename casually"). In French the open/closed state and size are saved under another id. Found while documenting.

comments.author: x74qtb63
comments.body: Fixed on DevHub-Plugins `Fix/boards-tool-window-id`: the Id is "boards". tools/I18n check now fails on any translated id (Id, IdPrefix, SectionId, an action's id), in both repositories.
